segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, thanks for making time. I wanted to confirm the quote for 42 seats of the analytics module and the June 3 go-live you mentioned last week.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, that's right. We have 38 users today, but finance wants four extra seats for the regional managers starting in Q3.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Makes sense. The pricing sheet puts that at $18,480 annually for the module, co-termed to your main agreement ending April 30, 2026. That would be a net new charge of $15,400 for the partial term.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And implementation is still the two remote sessions, right? No onsite work.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct. Two 90-minute sessions, included. We would schedule the admin session the week of May 20 and the end-user session the week of May 27, assuming signature by May 10.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That timeline works. On invoicing, can you keep it on the same billing account as our current subscription? AP doesn't want a separate vendor setup.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, same billing account and same PO number if you want. The billing tool will show it as an add-on line item under the existing subscription.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Use PO 44719, please. Legal already reviewed the main terms, so we should only need the order form.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Great. I'll send the order form today with the 42-seat quantity, $15,400 net new, and June 3 target go-live. Anything else you need on there?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Just include the service contact as me and the billing contact as Luis Moreno. If that's in there, I can route it for signature this afternoon.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. I'll get that over in the next hour.
